pages.text: Right, first lesson, and an easy one. Press &6K&r. That's your menu: &6Profile&r, &6Skills&r, &6Settings&r and the &6Journal&r, with a few more pages as you go along.
The Journal is my favourite. It lists every quest, chapter by chapter, and has a &6Track&r button that points a compass at where to go next. A little box on your screen shows the quest you're on.
Go on: press K, open the Journal page, and come tell me what you see. I'll be right here. I'm always right here.
